description: CAT-B, the contradiction of r-cat-1/names: decomposed 'Te'+U+0301 was a duplicate of precomposed U+00E9 at TableDefs.Append yet not found by TableDefs.Item. Two fresh databases, composed name first in one and decomposed first in the other. In each: create the first name by CREATE TABLE, then the other by DAO TableDefs.Append and by CREATE TABLE (each with DBEngine.Errors before and after), list TableDefs (refreshed), Item() by both spellings, open SELECT * FROM [..] by both spellings, DROP TABLE by the other spelling. Asks which layer treats the two spellings as one name.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
